cell: P11 bounded supervised streaming drain against real Redpanda/Kafka and PostgreSQL

implementation.summary: D43 adds a bounded supervised drain to the existing streaming run route with max_batches, max_records and idle_polls caps, repeated checkpoint-safe micro-batches, per-cycle bounded provider polling and explicit stop status/reason.

limitations: Earlier D43 attempts are retained as failures: one drained 32/64 because a one-shot provider poll object was reused; one lacked runner traffic evidence; one still drained 32/64 after the idle-poll change. The final implementation reinitializes the bounded provider poll per cycle and passed the real campaign.

The final campaign covers one bounded two-partition local Redpanda scenario and does not prove broker restart recovery, sustained indefinite backpressure, worker supervision, external providers or the full P11 family journey.
No gate closes and release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
